room.title: Add your first room
room.description:
Only the room name and the air conditioner are required. Leave anything you do not have empty.

**Which way the windows face** lets the controller work out when the sun is actually on the glass, which is what decides whether closing a blind would achieve anything. Light level cannot answer that — a semi-transparent blind reads bright when it is fully closed. It needs no extra sensor: it uses the sun position Home Assistant already knows.

**Lockout** means this room is never actuated. Leave it on "Not locked out" unless you mean it. The reason you choose is shown in the room's decision trace, and a reason you type is offered for every room afterwards.

bands.title: Comfort bands
bands.description:
The comfort band for this room, in HCI — not degrees. This is the only comfort setting there is; you never set a temperature. These values are already filled in and are meant to be changed.

Roughly: below 20 is cold, 20–23.5 cool, 23.5–27.5 comfortable, 27.5–31 warm, above 31 hot.

Clear both boxes of a mode you do not want. An office with no sleeping hours should clear the sleep pair.

abort.single_instance_allowed: HVAC Coordinator is already set up.

error.band_inverted: A band's lower bound must be below its upper bound.

edit_room.title: Edit a room
edit_room.description: Pick the room to change. Its current settings are prefilled.

remove_room.title: Remove a room
remove_room.description: The room's device and all its entities are removed with it. Learned model state for the room is discarded.

add_window.title: Add a tariff window
add_window.description:
Windows must cover the whole day exactly once, with no gaps and no overlaps. A window may run past midnight. The schedule is ignored until it is complete.

The rate is a label, not a price — this controller does no arithmetic on cost. Constraints are absolute rules, never traded against comfort. Constraints it does not act on itself are passed through and reported, for whichever system owns that actuator.

Untick coasting for a window where the room should be held even if the model says it would drift within band unaided — a cheap window where a battery is charging, for instance.

Current schedule:
{schedule}

outdoor.title: Outdoor temperature
outdoor.description:
The outdoor temperature the thermal model learns against. Without it the model cannot learn heat loss, so rooms never coast and the demand forecast falls back to an assumed duty cycle.

One feed serves the whole house.

error.band_inverted: A band's lower bound must be below its upper bound.
error.window_whole_day: A window covering the whole day can only be the only window. Remove the others first, or give this one a start and end.

heading_home.name: Heading home
heading_home.description: Brings a room to its comfort band ahead of arrival. This is the only thing that overrides an unoccupied room being off.

room_id.name: Room
room_id.description: The room to bring to comfort.

deadline.name: Deadline
deadline.description: Optional. When the room should have reached its comfort band.

clear_override.name: Clear override
clear_override.description: Drops any heading-home request for a room.

unrecognised_constraint.title: Tariff constraints this controller does not act on
unrecognised_constraint.description: The tariff declares {constraints}, which this controller does not act on itself. They are passed through for whichever system owns that actuator. Nothing is broken; this is a note that something else has to consume them.

room_without_bands.title: Rooms with no comfort bands
room_without_bands.description: {rooms} have no comfort bands configured, so they will never be actuated. Add bands from Configure, or set a lockout reason if that is deliberate.
